text:
I brought my mom in for botox today, and we had a wonderful experience with Sophia.

We contacted several places before making an appointment, but Sophia was by far the kindest and most informative. She took the time to answer all of our questions, which made us feel confident about choosing her.

When we met her in person today, she was just as warm, patient, and professional. She explained everything clearly and made my mom feel completely at ease. The preparation before the injections was very thorough, and everything was clean and hygienic.

My mom said that the injector's technique is so important, and Sophia's hands were incredibly gentle and precise. The injections were much more comfortable than she expected.

We truly appreciate Sophia's professionalism, attention to detail, and genuine care. We highly recommend her to anyone considering Botox treatments!

I recently received a high-concentration skin booster treatment, and I truly had such a wonderful experience. From the moment I arrived,  Dr. Sophia was warm, professional, and made me feel very comfortable. They carefully explained the procedure and answered all of my questions, which made me feel confident and relaxed throughout the treatment.
After the treatment, my skin looked noticeably more hydrated, radiant, and smooth. The glow was natural and healthy-looking, and my skin texture felt softer and refreshed. I especially loved how my skin looked brighter and more even without needing much makeup.
I’m very happy with my results and really appreciate the care and attention I received here. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for healthy, glowing skin and a professional skincare experience.
I’m also excited to try the new Oligio X treatment next time!

Had an amazing experience at SuA Glow. I was a bit nervous about getting Botox on my jaw and frown lines, but the consultation was so thorough that I felt instantly at ease.

The clinic itself is beautiful, clean, and the staff are professional. The procedure was quick, painless, and the results are so natural. Highly recommend if you want that perfect K-beauty glow!

I absolutely loved working with Sophia and Bianca. They both did an amazing job and were incredibly informative throughout the entire process.

I got the Oligio X and Skin Booster treatments done, and even though it’s only my second day, I’m already loving the results!

I first met Sophia during my skin consultation, and she took the time to thoroughly explain everything to me. She was patient, knowledgeable, and made sure I felt comfortable before moving forward.

On the day of the procedure, she walked me through every step, explaining what each treatment was for again, how it would help my skin, and what to expect. She was very detailed, informative, and supportive throughout the entire experience, which made me feel comfortable and reassured.

I had such a great experience and will by my go to skin treatment spot in DFW from now.

Had a phenomenal consultation with Sophia! I left genuinely excited. She has a deep understanding of anti-aging and skin rejuvenation and you can tell she’s passionate about the science behind it. I typically spend hours doing my own research on regenerative treatments but walked away feeling way more informed after talking with her. Definitely looking forward to starting my treatments here.
